note: A paywall whose page is a `scroll` taller than the phone, for the Nux machine suite: a component shown as a cover, drawn from its .nux source alone. The four .nux files are copied from the views-scroll fixture folder of the parent's .nux compiler crate, each named here by its git blob id at parentCommit. The plan is the three program files; main.test.nux holds the folder's tests and is copied for provenance only, never handed to the session or compiled on the device. The plan's views are compiled on the device; nothing else is published.
